regime_context: Memory, HBM & Storage leads with a wide margin but is fading with low durability (0.59). The absolute-trend gate is historically helpful for drawdown control on US equity themes. Crowding is present in challenger themes like Cybersecurity and Managed Care, but the rotation margin remains large. Past calls have been unreliable (dir_accuracy 0.2), so any leans are tentative.
emerging_watch: Cybersecurity – watch for potential leadership handoff if Memory theme continues to fade. Kill criterion: margin between Memory and Cybersecurity widens to >4.0 OR Cybersecurity's durability_bar drops below 0.7.
